clips.title: Asking Strangers About Same-Sex Marriage
grammar: 〜ていいですか — may I / is it okay to

lines.ja: 男同士、女同士の結婚について賛成か反対かを聞いてまして、どうですかね？
lines.en: We're asking people if they agree with or disagree with same-sex marriage. What do you think?
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: 賛成です、全然。全然賛成です。
lines.speaker: Interviewees

lines.ja: じゃあ、それぞれ理由をお聞きしていいですか？
lines.en: Then, could you tell me your reasons?
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: やっぱり愛に男女関係ないかなって思うんで。
lines.en: Well, I think gender doesn't really matter when it comes to love.
lines.speaker: Woman

lines.ja: 人それぞれだなと思うので、
lines.speaker: Woman

lines.ja: その人たちの幸せのためだと思うので、
lines.en: and since I think it's for their happiness,
lines.speaker: Woman

lines.en: I think it's a good thing.
lines.speaker: Woman

clips.title: As Long as They Love Each Other
grammar: 〜なら — if / in the case of
〜わけじゃない — it doesn't mean that

lines.ja: 好き同士なら別にいいと思います。
lines.en: If they love each other, I think it's totally fine.
lines.speaker: Woman B

lines.ja: 周りに迷惑かけるわけじゃないですしね。
lines.en: It's not like they're causing problems for others.
lines.speaker: Woman A
